This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. This one is next level tasty 🤤   a top-notch heavy appetizer, perfect to bring to a party or to serve at your next gathering.  alll ingredients are from @ALDI USA 🧡 #summerrecipes #tomatoes #burrata #EasyRecipes #healthyrecipes #healthylifestyle #burratafilling #roastedtomatoes #easyappetizer #cheesydip #garlicbread #tomatoburratadip #tiktokfoodie #viralrecipe #cheesepull #easyrecipes #summerappetizer #dinnerpartyideas #homemadegoodness #heavyappetizers, #foodtutorials, #gourmetfood, #partyfood, #appetizers, #fingerfood, #recipeideas,  #appetizer, #foodtutorial, #partyfood, #gourmet #creatorsearchinsights #carlyscookbook  #alditiktok #aldi

Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

Bala baiana! These are Brazilian coconut bob bons! My friend @KITCHENTOOL thanks for the recipe! I searched so many recipes and his is the easiest to follow in my opinion! Check his page out! Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Caramelized Onion and Garlic Spaghetti 🔥 Minimal effort, max comfort. Sweet, savory, a little spicy... this one hits every note. Tip: Best served with with chicken, shrimp, or tofu 🫡 Ingredients: -1 large onion, thinly sliced -4 garlic cloves, minced -2 tbsp chili crisp -1 cup of cream or coconut milk, room temperature -1 tbsp soy sauce, optional -1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese, grated -8 oz (225g) pasta of your choice -2 tbsp butter -1 tbsp olive oil -Seasonings (1 tsp each): paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, italian seasoning 1. Slice your onion like it owes you money, mince that garlic (use fresh please), and measure out all your seasoning. Bring a cup of cream or coconut milk to room temperature. 2. Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add in the onions and let them vibe for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and jammy. If they start sticking, hit ‘em with a splash of water. 3. While your onions are caramelizing like sweet little angels, boil a pot of salted water and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain, but don’t forget to save some of that pasta water — it’s liquid gold. 4. When the onions are deeply golden, stir in your minced garlic and all the seasonings. Let it all bloom for a minute, then add the chili crisp and saute for a minute. Pour in your cream (or coconut milk). Let it simmer and get cozy for a few minutes then add the grated Parmesan cheese. 5. Add your pasta to the sauce and toss to coat. Use that reserved pasta water to loosen things up if it’s too thick — you’re going for silky, not sticky. 6. Serve hot with an extra spoon of chili crisp on top for a spicy kick and maybe a sprinkle of fresh parsley if you’re feelin’ fancy. #recipe #dinnerideastiktok #dinner

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

Blanket Dumplings 🥟 These dumplings definitely live up to the hype. They’re by far the quickest and easiest way to make homemade dumplings, and you can have them on the table in under 25 minutes. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Zdecydowanie jeden z tych przepisów, które warto zapisać! Zapisz i wyślij komuś, z kim zjadłbyś całą patelnię! #food #foodtok #cooking #recipe #dumplings

The high-protein, low-carb dinner I wish I knew about sooner… and best part, it only takes 15 minutes!! #RECIPE Enoki Beef Rolls 🍄 Ingredients (3-4 servings): 1 lb thinly sliced beef (I used “shabu shabu beef”) 7 oz enoki mushrooms 1 white onion, thinly sliced 1 tbsp oil (avocado oil preferred) 2 eggs, whisked Garnish: chopped green onions, sesame seeds Sauce: 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 garlic clove, minced Dash of pepper 🥩 Instructions: Prep the mushrooms – Trim the bottom 1-2 inches off the enoki mushrooms, rinse, and separate into small bundles. Roll it up – Lay out a slice of beef and roll each enoki bundle tightly inside. Repeat until all are wrapped. Make the sauce – Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Sauté the onions – Heat oil in a large skillet over med-high heat, add onions, and cook for 3min until softened. Cook the rolls – Place the beef rolls over the onions in a single layer, pour in the sauce, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low-med and simmer for 3min (until beef is cooked through). Add the eggs – Uncover, pour whisked eggs over the rolls, cover again, and cook for 1min.  Finish & serve – Salt to taste. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! #creatorsearchinsights

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

I’ve been seeing this chicken au poivre everywhere and wanted to try it.  Recipies below ⬇️ Bread Recipe: •4 cups bread flour (500g) •1½ cups + 1 tbsp warm water (375g) •2¼ tsp instant yeast (7g) @fleischmannsyeast  •1¾ tsp salt (10g) •2 tsp honey (10g) Mix water, honey, yeast, flour, and salt until just combined and sticky. Cover and rise 1½–2 hrs, doing 3–4 folds every 30 min. Divide into 3, shape, and proof 30–45 min. Score and bake at 475°F with steam for 10 min. Reduce to 450°F and bake 12–18 min until deeply golden. Cool 30 min before slicing. Chicken Au Poivre: •8 chicken thighs (bone-in + skin on)  seasonings: chicken soup blend, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, white pepper. •3 tbsp unsalted butter  •1 shallot  •3 garlic cloves  •1/4 cup light brandy  •1 cup chicken stock  •2 cups heavy whipping cream  •2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper  •1.5 tbsp fresh rosemary  •1 tbsp dijon mustard  •1 tbsp worcestershire sauce  •salt to taste  Sear chicken skin side down first for 25 minutes on low heat until golden, then flip and allow to cook another 10 minutes. Set chicken aside, add in butter, shallots and cook down for 1-2 minutes. Then add in garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Deglaze with brandy, and add in chicken stock, HWC, pepper, rosemary, Dijon, Worcestershire, and salt. Throw chicken + juices back in and allow to simmer on low for 25-30 mins.  Cheesy potato puree gratin: •8-10 medium Yukon gold potatoes  •1 stick of butter  •3 garlic cloves  •fresh rosemary + thyme  •2 cups milk  •white pepper  •grated nutmeg  •Parmesan cheese + mozzarella. Boil potatoes in heavily salted water until super tender. Melt butter in a sauce pan, cook garlic for 30 seconds, add in rosemary and thyme and cook for another 30 seconds, then add in milk, white pepper, and grated nutmeg, and salt to taste. Mix in riced potatoes with milk, and cheeses. Throw potatoes into a baking dish and broil until the top is golden.  Brussel sprouts seasoned with garlic butter herb seasoning + olive oil and baked at 450 for 20-25 mins .  Creme brûlée: •2 cups heavy cream  •1 vanilla bean (extract or paste work too) •6 egg yolks @Happy Egg  •1/2 cup sugar  •pinch of salt  Heat the heavy cream + vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk egg yolks, sugar, and salt. Slowly whisk in the hot cream to temper eggs then add in the rest. Pour into ramekins. Place in a water bath and bake at 325°F until set with a slight jiggle (40-60 mins varying by oven). Cool and refrigerate. Sprinkle sugar on top and torch until golden and crisp.  #chickenaupoivre #mashedpotatoes #cheesypotatopureegratin #homemadebread #cremebrulee

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

One-Tray Caramelized Onion & Garlic Pasta 🔥 For all of you asking… the app is called Osta and is  linked in my bio or you can search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play store 🫶 Minimal effort, max comfort. Sweet, savory, a little spicy... this one has all the flavor. Tip: Best served with with chicken, shrimp, or tofu 🫡 Ingredients: -2 large onions, thinly sliced -1 whole garlic head -2 tbsp chili crisp @momofukugoods  -1 1/2 cups of cream or coconut milk (room temp) -1 tbsp soy sauce (optional) -1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese, grated -1/2 lemon, juiced -12 oz (340 g) pasta of choice -5 tbsp olive oil -Pasta water (as needed) -Seasonings: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp pepper, 2 tsp italian seasoning Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Add sliced onions to a baking dish. Toss with paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and 4 tbsp olive oil until well coated. 2. Slice the top off the garlic head (about ¼ inch), drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with salt, and place it cut-side up on top of the onions.  3. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour, tossing the onions every 20 minutes (twice total). Each time, add a splash of water to prevent burning. You’re looking for deep golden, jammy onions. 4. While that magic is happening, cook pasta according to package instructions. Reserve up to 1 cup of pasta water before draining. 5. Remove garlic from the dish and let cool slightly (freezer hack = elite move). Squeeze the roasted garlic into the onions. 6. Add chili crisp, cream (or coconut milk), soy sauce (if using), lemon juice, Parmesan, and cooked pasta. Toss everything together, adding some pasta water as needed until glossy and saucy. Taste and adjust salt if needed. 7. Finish with extra Parmesan, chili crisp, and fresh parsley if you’re feeling fancy. #dinnerideas #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #fyp #cookingtiktok

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

👀🍫FUDGY BROWNIE CHEESECAKE BARS…  No baking required. Makes 7 BIG bars, each with: 240 cals, 10g protein, 10 net carbs Here is another viral recipe that absolutely holds up to the hype. You’ve got a rich brownie base, a creamy cheesecake center, and a chocolate layer right on top. These are a little more dense than your traditional brownie cheesecake bar, but made with better-for-you ingredients, incredibly satisfying, and SO GOOD. Big thanks to @nora.dora99 for this amazing recipe! Here’s how to make them: FOR THE BROWNIE BASE: 150g almond flour 30g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 3 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Splash of vanilla extract Mix everything together until you have a brownie batter. Press it firmly into a parchment-lined loaf pan or small baking dish and freeze for 10 mins. FOR THE CHEESECAKE LAYER: 250g fat-free cream cheese (regular works too!) 10g sweetener of choice Splash of vanilla extract Squeeze of lemon juice I processed this in a food processor, but you can also use a hand mixer. Then spread it over the brownie base and freeze for about 45 mins. FOR THE CHOCOLATE TOPPING: 40g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Mix until smooth, spread it over the cheesecake layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. I cut these into 7 bars, but you can cut them into whatever size bars you like to manage your own goals. Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3. My take on the viral beef kebab roll ups 😮‍💨🔥  What You’ll Need: For the Beef 	•	1 lb ground beef (80/20 works best) 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced onion 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced bell pepper 	•	Small handful fresh parsley, finely chopped 	•	2 garlic cloves, minced 	•	1 tsp curry powder 	•	1 tsp beef bouillon 	•	1 tsp garlic powder 	•	1 tsp onion powder 	•	1 tsp black pepper 	•	2 tsp paprika 	•	½ tsp cumin 	•	Salt to taste For Assembly 	•	Lavash bread or large flour tortillas 	•	Wooden skewers, soaked in water For the Chili Butter 	•	2 tbsp butter 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	1 tsp tomato paste 	•	3 tsp paprika 	•	Salt to taste 	•	Optional: pinch of chili flakes for heat For Serving 	•	Plain yogurt or garlic yogurt 	•	Fresh parsley 	•	Lemon wedges How To Make Them Mix together the ground beef, onion, bell pepper, garlic, parsley, olive oil, and seasonings until smooth and slightly sticky. Cover and refrigerate for 20–30 minutes while soaking your skewers in water. Spread a thin layer of the beef mixture onto lavash bread or tortillas, roll tightly, then slice into pieces. Thread onto skewers, packing them closely together. Bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and cooked through. For the chili butter, melt together the butter and olive oil, then stir in the tomato paste, paprika, salt, and chili flakes if using. Let it cook for 30 seconds until glossy and fragrant. Brush the skewers generously with the chili butter, then broil for 1–2 minutes until lightly charred and crispy around the edges.
